properties.html: A leakage can empty the full tank in 6 hrs if it works alone, but when a tap is also opened which is filling the water in the tank at the rate of 2litre/min then the leakage takes 8 hours to empty the tank. Find the capacity of the tank (in litres).

properties.html: Ravi, Chada and Teaj can do a piece of work in 10, 12 and 20 days, respectively. If it is known that 1st day only Ravi works, 2nd day only Chada and 3rd day only Teaj work, 4th day only Ravi works and so on till the end of the work. Then in what ratio will the three get the payment.

properties.html: Priya can do a piece of work in 12 days. Heena is thrice as efficient as Priya. Priya works on the first day alone, Heena works on the second day alone, and then on the third day onwards, both of them work together. How many days would they take to complete the work?

properties.html: After working for 8 days, Sagar finds that only (2/5)th of the work has been done. Then he employs Vivek who is 80% as efficient as Sagar. How many days more would Vivek take to complete the remaining (3/5)th of work, if he works alone?

properties.html: The ratio of efficiency of pipe A and pipe B is 5: 8. A third pipe C empty the tank in 90 hours. If pipe A alone filled the same tank in 60 hours, then in how many hours all three pipe filled the tank together?

properties.html: Munir alone can finish a piece of work in 156 days. A new person with the same efficiency as him joins him every 3rd day, 5th day, 7th day, and so on until the work is finished. In how many days work will be finished?

properties.html: A, B, and C can together finish a job in 1 day. The efficiency of A is thrice that of C and the efficiency of B is twice that of C. What is the ratio of the number of days taken by A and B alone to finish the job to the number of days taken by B and C alone to finish the job?
